name: How do I choose the right contractor for back entrance accessibility upgrades?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for back entrance accessibility upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves evaluating their experience with accessibility projects, checking references, and reviewing their portfolio. Ensure they are licensed, insured, and familiar with local building codes and ADA guidelines, even for residential projects. A good contractor will conduct a thorough on-site assessment, offer clear communication, provide a detailed proposal, and demonstrate an understanding of your specific needs and challenges related to accessibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on their accessibility project experience, references, licensing, insurance, knowledge of local codes, clear communication, and detailed proposals.
